newsitem.title: USA: American Residential buys boost revenues.
newsitem.headline: American Residential buys boost revenues.

text.p: American Residential Services Inc said its total annualized revenues acquired during the first quarter rose to $32 million after three recent acquisitions.

The acquisitions -- Grand Rapids, Michigan-based Energy Concepts Inc; Oaklahoma City-based Advanced Air-Co & Heating Inc; and Tri-State/Broome Heating and Air of Wahalla, South Carolina -- added $14 million in annualized reveunes, American Residential said.

"These three new acquisitions bring our annualized revenue 'run rate' to approximately $260 million and give us a strategic presence in two important new markets as well as an increased presence in South Carolina," said Cliff Wright, the company's president and chief executive officer.
The company did not say how much the acquisitions would contribute to earnings. American Residential officials were not immediately available to comment further.
The company provides residential heating, air conditioning, plumbing, electrical and appliance services.
